params.message:
Ask and a morning mail say what waits at the desk and what is off

What the Observatory needs from a person piles up quietly: sources that
wait for a trial, trials whose verdict is in, recommendations left by an
assistant, sources the collector parked. One read counts it, with who can
act on each line. Ask closes the first answer of a conversation with it,
and a morning mail brings it to the desk when the list changed.

Portal: De redactie hoort van Ask en in een ochtendmail wat op hen wacht en wat uit staat, en kan het door Ask laten afhandelen.
